cards.front: Se tarda media hora en llegar a la playa desde aquí.

cards.back: It takes half an hour to get to the mountains from here.

cards.front: Se tarda mucho tiempo en aprender un idioma.

cards.back: It takes a long time to learn how to drive.

cards.back: It takes a long time to learn how to play the piano.

cards.front: Tardo cinco minutos en llegar al trabajo.
cards.back: It takes me five minutes to get to work.

cards.back: It takes you a long time to get up in the morning.

cards.back: It only takes Mark ten minutes to get to work.

cards.back: It only takes one year to learn how to speak English well.

cards.back: It only takes them half an hour to get to the beach from their house.

cards.back: It takes her five minutes to have a shower.

cards.front: Sólo tardo dos minutos en ducharme.
cards.back: It only takes me two minutes to have a shower.

cards.front: Él tarda media hora en ducharse.
cards.back: It takes him half an hour to have a shower.

cards.front: No se tarda diez minutos en llegar allí; se tarda media hora.
cards.back: It doesn't take ten minutes to get there; it takes half an hour.

cards.front: No se tarda una hora en hacerlo; sólo se tarda media hora.
cards.back: It doesn't take an hour to do that; it only takes half an hour.

cards.front: No se tarda media hora en llegar a Cáceres desde aquí. Se tarda una hora.
cards.back: It doesn't take half an hour to get to Cáceres from here. It takes an hour.

cards.front: Él no tarda media hora en llegar al trabajo, tarda una hora y media.
cards.back: It doesn't take him half an hour to get to work, it takes him an hour and a half.

cards.front: Mi hija no tarda una hora en levantarse por la mañana, ¡tarda una hora y media!
cards.back: It doesn't take my daughter an hour to get up in the morning, it takes her an hour and a half!

cards.front: No se tarda una hora y media en llegar a la playa desde aquí.
cards.back: It doesn't take an hour and a half to get to the beach from here.

cards.front: No se suele tardar mucho tiempo en preparar pasta.
cards.back: It doesn't usually take very long to make pasta.

cards.front: No tardo mucho tiempo en hacer la compra cada semana.
cards.back: It doesn't take me long to do the shopping every week.

cards.front: Suelen tardar mucho tiempo en ducharse, pero yo no tardo mucho tiempo en ducharme.
cards.back: It usually takes them a long time to have a shower, but it doesn't take me long to have a shower.

cards.front: ¡No se tarda tanto tiempo en aprender a hablar bien inglés!
cards.back: It doesn't take that long to learn how to speak English well!

cards.front: ¡No tardo tanto tiempo en hacer las tareas domésticas!
cards.back: It doesn't take me that long to do the housework!

cards.front: ¡No tardamos tanto tiempo en llegar a casa desde el trabajo!
cards.back: It doesn't take us that long to get home from work!

cards.back: It usually takes half an hour to brush your teeth.

cards.front: ¡No se tarda tanto en lavarse los dientes!
cards.back: It doesn't take that long!

cards.front: No tardo mucho en cepillarme los dientes.
cards.back: It doesn't take me very long to brush my teeth.

cards.front: Él tampoco tarda mucho tiempo en lavarse los dientes.
cards.back: It doesn't take him long to brush his teeth either.

cards.front: ¿Puedes llevar este informe a recepción, por favor?
cards.back: Can you take this report to reception, please?

cards.front: ¿Le llevas esto a Martin, por favor?
cards.back: Can you take this to Martin, please?

cards.front: ¿Puedes llevar tus cosas a tu habitación, por favor?
cards.back: Can you take your things to your room, please?

cards.front: ¡No olvides llevar contigo las llaves de tu coche!
cards.back: Don't forget to take your car keys with you!

cards.front: ¡No olvides llevar contigo el libro 13 de Vaughan Intensive English!
cards.back: Don't forget to take book 13 of Vaughan Intensive English with you!

cards.front: ¡No olvides llevar tu pasaporte!
cards.back: Don't forget to take your passport with you!

cards.front: Los viernes llevo a mi madre a la estación de trenes.
cards.back: On Fridays, I take my mother to the train station.

cards.front: ¿Llevas a tus hijos al parque los domingos?
cards.back: Do you take your children to the park on Sundays?

cards.front: No llevo a mis padres a la biblioteca los jueves.
cards.back: I don't take my parents to the library on Thursdays.

cards.front: A veces llevo a mi vecino al trabajo.
cards.back: I sometimes take my neighbour to work.

cards.front: A veces llevo a mi hijo al colegio.
cards.back: I sometimes take my son to school.

cards.front: A veces mi amigo Paul también lleva a sus hijos al cole.
cards.back: My friend Paul sometimes takes his children to school too.

cards.front: ¿Llevas algo de dinero encima?
cards.back: Do you have any money on you?

cards.back: I don't have any money on me.

cards.front: Sólo llevo tres dólares encima.
cards.back: I only have three bucks on me.

cards.front: Voy a tomar jarabe para la tos.
cards.back: I'm going to take some cough medicine for my cough.

cards.front: Voy a tomar una aspirina para el dolor de cabeza.
cards.back: I'm going to take an aspirin for my headache.

cards.front: ¡Ten! Tómate uno de estos analgésicos para la espalda.
cards.back: Here you go! Take one of these painkillers for your back.

cards.front: ¿Te vas a tomar un descanso?
cards.back: Are you going to take a break?

cards.back: I'm not going to take a break until five o'clock.

cards.front: Él se va a tomar un descanso antes de las cinco.
cards.back: He's going to take a break before five o'clock.

cards.front: John se va a coger unos días a principios de agosto.
cards.back: John's going to take a few days off at the beginning of August.

cards.front: ¿Vas a coger unos días a finales de julio?
cards.back: Are you going to take a few days off at the end of July?

cards.front: Voy a coger unos días a principios de febrero y también un día a finales de marzo.
cards.back: I'm going to take a few days off at the beginning of February and I'm also going to take a day off at the end of March.

cards.front: Tómate una aspirina, toma un descanso y ¡tómate las cosas con calma!
cards.back: Take an aspirin, take a break and take it easy!

cards.front: ¡Relájate! ¡No tiene tanta importancia!
cards.back: Take it easy! It's not that important!

cards.front: ¡Tómate las cosas con calma! ¡Cógete unos cuantos días libres!
cards.back: Take it easy! Take a few days off!

cards.front: ¿Estás tomándote este curso en serio?

cards.front: Tómate el inglés en serio. ¡Es importante!
cards.back: Take your English seriously. It's important!

cards.front: ¡Voy a tomarme en serio el inglés este año!
cards.back: I'm going to take my English seriously this year!
